001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.Solution;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.Solver;
006import org.clafer.choco.ResetKeepsLimits;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Constraint;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
011import org.clafer.common.Check;
012import org.clafer.instance.InstanceModel;
013
014/**
015 * Takes an improvement-style optimizer that only returns one solution per
016 * Pareto point and extends it to find all solutions per Pareto point.
017 *
018 * @author jimmy
019 */
020public class EquivalentParetoSolver implements ClaferOptimizer {
021
022    private final AbstractImprovementOptimizer optimizer;
023    private int count = 0;
024    private boolean more = true;
025    private Solution paretoSolution = null;
026    private int paretoCount = 0;
027    private Constraint[] equivalentConstraint;
028
029    public EquivalentParetoSolver(AbstractImprovementOptimizer optimizer) {
030        this.optimizer = Check.notNull(optimizer);
031    }
032
033    @Override
034    public boolean find() {
035        if (!more) {
036            return false;
037        }
038        Solver solver = getInternalSolver();
039        if (paretoSolution == null) {
040            more &= optimizer.find();
041            if (!more) {
042                return false;
043            }
044            paretoCount = 1;
045            paretoSolution = optimizer.solution();
046        } else {
047            if (paretoCount == 1) {
048                ResetKeepsLimits.reset(solver);
049                solver.getModel().clearObjective();
050                IntVar[] scores = optimizer.getScores();
051                int[] paretoPoint = optimizer.optimalValues();
052                equivalentConstraint = new Constraint[paretoPoint.length];
053                for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++) {
054                    equivalentConstraint[i] = solver.getModel().arithm(scores[i], "=", paretoPoint[i]);
055                    equivalentConstraint[i].post();
056                }
057            }
058            boolean next = solver.solve();
059            if (solver.isStopCriterionMet()) {
060                more = false;
061                throw new ReachedLimitException();
062            }
063            if (next) {
064                paretoCount++;
065            } else {
066                for (Constraint c : equivalentConstraint) {
067                    if (c != null) {
068                        solver.getModel().unpost(c);
069                    }
070                }
071                paretoSolution = null;
072                return find();
073            }
074            if (duplicateSolution()) {
075                return find();
076            }
077        }
078        if (more) {
079            count++;
080        }
081        return more;
082    }
083
084    @Override
085    public InstanceModel instance() {
086        if (count == 0 || !more) {
087            throw new IllegalStateException("No instances. Did you forget to call find?");
088        }
089        return paretoCount == 1 ? optimizer.instance() : optimizer.getSolutionMap().getInstance();
090    }
091
092    @Override
093    public int[] optimalValues() {
094        return optimizer.optimalValues();
095    }
096
097    @Override
098    public int instanceCount() {
099        return count;
100    }
101
102    @Override
103    public Solver getInternalSolver() {
104        return optimizer.getInternalSolver();
105    }
106
107    private boolean duplicateSolution() {
108        if (paretoSolution == null) {
109            return false;
110        }
111        for (IntVar var : optimizer.getSolutionMap().getIrSolution().getIntVars()) {
112            if ((var.getTypeAndKind() & Variable.CSTE) == 0) {
113                if (var.getValue() != paretoSolution.getIntVal(var)) {
114                    return false;
115                }
116            }
117        }
118        for (SetVar var : optimizer.getSolutionMap().getIrSolution().getSetVars()) {
119            if ((var.getTypeAndKind() & Variable.CSTE) == 0) {
120                if (!Arrays.equals(var.getLB().toArray(), paretoSolution.getSetVal(var))) {
121                    return false;
122                }
123            }
124        }
125        return true;
126    }
127}
